name: Ruth Han
want: get out of this town for good
secret: She fixed a handheld radio and heard a rescue convoy broadcast heading to a coastal safe zone. It said they can only take three more people. She hasn't told anyone.
voice: Short sentences, long silences, rarely smiles.
description: A mechanic who would rather fix things than talk about them. Keeps to herself and her toolbox, and notices more than she says.
appearance: Lean, with black hair tied back under a bandana, oil-stained overalls and a socket wrench in her back pocket.
